info.title: SBOL DB V2 API
info.description:
The native REST API for SBOL DB, mounted under `/api/v2`.

V2 calls the same application services as the V1 SynBioHub compatibility adapter: both read and write the same dataset, while retaining separate wire contracts. V2 uses proper HTTP verbs (POST creates, PATCH edits, DELETE deletes, and no GET mutates), JSON request bodies, real pagination with a total, `Accept`-driven content negotiation, a single consistent error envelope, and bearer or same-origin browser-session authentication. V1 preserves classic SynBioHub behavior only where compatibility requires it.

When public browsing is enabled, a missing or unrecognized resource credential is anonymous and scoped to the public graph. An instance with `requireLogin` rejects anonymous resource requests with `401` while retaining public bootstrap and session routes. A mutating verb attempted anonymously is `403`; invalid login credentials are `401`. Reads are ACL-scoped to the caller's authorized graphs, and an out-of-scope object is a non-disclosing `404`.

bearerAuth.description: An `Authorization: Bearer <token>` credential. A missing or unrecognized token is anonymous when public browsing is enabled; `requireLogin` instances reject anonymous resource requests.

cookieAuth.name: sbol-db-token
cookieAuth.description: The HttpOnly browser session established by `POST /session`. Bearer credentials take precedence. Unsafe cookie-authenticated requests must be same-origin.

name.description: Optional deployment context shown beneath the fixed SBOL DB product identity.

front_page_text.description: Instance-authored front-page prose. Treat as untrusted content when rendering.

setup_required.description: True until the instance has its first administrator.

password_reset.description: False until a reset-token delivery worker is configured.

identifier.description: An account username or email. `email` and `username` are accepted as compatibility aliases.

AccountPatch.description: Caller-owned profile fields. Omission preserves a field and an empty affiliation clears it.

user.description: The recipient's username or email address.

curator.description: The assigned curator's username or email.

AdminUser.description: A safe account projection. Password hashes, reset links, and tokens are never present.

confirmation.description: The exact target-specific phrase documented by the operation.

idempotency_key.description: Required for pre_deploy; use a release or commit identifier.

hostname.description: Canonical DNS name for native ACME TLS.

backup_recovery_recipient.description: Public age X25519 recipient; the recovery identity is never stored by this API.

backup_repository_url.description: Credential-free s3:// or gs:// bucket and instance prefix.

EdgeSettingsPatch.description: Every property is optional; supplied values replace pending settings and apply after restart.

health.description: Live TLS, ACME lifecycle, and managed-disk health.

Error.description: The single V2 error envelope. Every non-2xx response carries this shape.

code.description: A stable machine-readable code, shared with the native surface.

status.description: The HTTP status code, echoed for clients that only read the body.

score.description: The relevance score. Zero for unranked browse-only objects.

total.description: The total number of in-scope matches, independent of the returned window.

label.description: Ontology term name when loaded, otherwise a compact IRI fallback.

count.description: Distinct visible top-level objects carrying this value.

strategy.description: A registered strategy id. Absent selects the configured default.

SbolObjectRecord.description: The derived object record: idiomatic JSON metadata for one SBOL object.

ObjectContentState.description: Explicitly distinguishes present content, asserted emptiness, incomplete modeling, and biology that does not apply.

ObjectDetails.description: The ACL-scoped object-page projection assembled by the backend-neutral application service.

id.description: The submission id, the collection segment of every minted URI.

version.description: The version segment of every minted URI.

creator_name.description: The creator name; defaults to the caller's display name.

format.description: The input serialization: `rdfxml` (default), `turtle`, `jsonld`, `ntriples`, `genbank`, or `fasta`. Sequence formats are converted to SBOL 3 before minting.

member.description: The absolute IRI of an existing object.

PatchRequest.description: The mutable fields a PATCH may edit. Every field is optional; a present field is applied, an absent one is left untouched.

citations.description: The full PubMed citation list, replacing the current one when present.

overwrite.description: Collision policy against the public collection URI: `fail` (default), `replace`, or `merge`.

Error.description: An error, in the V2 envelope.

iri.name: iri
iri.description: The object IRI as a single percent-encoded path segment.

get.description: The V2 version and health endpoint. Unauthenticated.

200.description: The service name, API generation, and version.

get.description: Safe branding, public access policy, setup state, and feature discovery for the portal. Admin-only configuration and secrets are never included.
Returns a safe account projection for the selected bearer or browser credential. Logged-out state is a normal `200` with `authenticated: false`.

200.description: The authenticated account, or explicit anonymous state.

post.description: Verifies a username/email and password, then establishes the shared HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax browser cookie. The opaque token is never returned in JSON. Explicitly cross-origin browser requests are rejected.

delete.description: Revokes the selected token and expires the browser cookie. Idempotent for anonymous or stale credentials. Cookie-authenticated requests must be same-origin.

204.description: The selected token was revoked when present and the cookie was expired.

get.description: Returns the authenticated caller's safe profile. Password material, tokens, and unrelated administrator settings are never included.

patch.description: Updates only caller-owned display name and affiliation fields. Identity, email, and role fields are immutable through self-service.

post.description: Re-verifies the current password before replacing its Argon2 hash. Neither password is logged or returned.

get.summary: List objects shared with the current account
get.description: Returns exact read-only shares visible to the caller, ordered by canonical IRI and projected through the ordinary ACL boundary.

get.summary: List the current account's review queue
get.description: Returns the latest review cycle for objects the caller submitted or was assigned. Administrators receive the complete queue.

200.description: Relevant review cases in deterministic object-IRI order.

get.description: The paginated, ACL-scoped object list. Shares the normalized discovery contract and response envelope with `/search`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A free-text term. Absent browses the whole in-scope corpus.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Restrict to one rdf:type, given as a full IRI.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Restrict to one SBOL role, given as a full IRI.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Restrict to direct members of this collection IRI.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Restrict to objects owned by this user graph IRI.

parameters.name: provenance
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring over mutable provenance.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Defaults to ascending for name/IRI and descending otherwise.

200.description: A page of ranked objects with a total.

get.description: Read one object under the caller's authorized graph scope. An explicit `format` is a closure download; otherwise the representation is chosen by `Accept`: `application/json` (the default) returns idiomatic JSON metadata, and an RDF media type returns the object's RDF closure. An out-of-scope or absent object is a non-disclosing `404`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: A download format: `sbol`, `sbolnr`, `gb`, `fasta`, `gff`, or `omex`. When absent, the representation is negotiated from `Accept`.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: `sbol2` or `sbol3` (default) for the RDF-bearing formats.

200.description: The object as JSON metadata, an RDF closure, or a download, per `format`/`Accept`.

patch.description: Edit the object's mutable fields in place. Identity-gated: an anonymous caller is `403`, a non-owner is rejected by the facade.

200.description: The edited object record, or `{ "iri": ... }` for a verbatim submission with no derived record.

delete.description: Remove a top-level object and everything whose `sbh:topLevel` names it. Identity-gated; a missing object is `404`, an unauthorized caller is `403`.

get.description: Return the normalized object-page resource under the caller's authorized graph scope. Identity, provenance, biological relationships, collections, attachments, uses, twins, and exact RDF properties carry explicit availability states. Unknown and out-of-scope objects are both non-disclosing `404` responses.
Returns append-only sharing, transfer, and review evidence. Restricted to an owner or administrator because events identify participating accounts.

200.description: The object's immutable collaboration event stream.

get.description: Returns the latest immutable review cycle to an owner, assigned curator, requestor, or administrator.

post.description: Atomically grants the assigned active curator read-only access and appends an immutable review-request event. The caller must own the object or be an administrator.
Appends an approval or changes-requested event to the pending review. The assigned curator or an administrator may decide; history is never rewritten.

get.description: Returns owners and read-only viewers as distinct groups. Only an owner or administrator may inspect this management projection.

200.description: The object's owners and read-only viewers.

post.description: Grants an active member read-only access without making them an owner. This is distinct from the classic co-owner compatibility operation.

delete.description: Removes one read-only viewer without changing ownership.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The viewer's percent-encoded username or email.

put.description: Atomically replaces the caller's ownership stamps with the selected active member. An administrator who is not an owner cannot use this self-service operation to reassign an object.

post.description: Publish a private object to the public graph under freshly minted public URIs (classic makePublic). Identity-gated.

201.description: The object was published. The `Location` header points to the public collection.

get.description: The object's in-scope sequence-cluster mates, ranked by PageRank.

200.description: The cluster mates with a total.

post.description: Mint a submission into the caller's user namespace. Accepts a JSON body (the SBOL document in a `content` field) or a `multipart/form-data` upload (the document in a `file` part). Identity-gated: an anonymous caller is `403`.

citations.description: A comma-separated list of PubMed ids.

201.description: The collection was minted. The `Location` header points to it.

post.description: Runs the same parsing, validation, optional GenBank/FASTA conversion, identity minting, and collision analysis as commit without persisting anything. Requires an active member or administrator account.

200.description: A write-free validation and identity preview.

delete.description: Removes an owned collection and the closure belonging to that submission. This broader operation is separate from generic object deletion.

post.description: Adds one exact `sbol:member` edge to an owned collection.

delete.description: Removes one exact `sbol:member` edge from an owned collection.

get.description: Returns the active backend capabilities, immutable search deployment, and the native admin sections. Requires an authenticated administrator.

patch.summary: Update instance identity and public policy

200.description: Local accounts without credentials or reset material.

patch.summary: Update an account profile and roles
patch.description: Username and account graph identity remain immutable. Self-demotion and removal of the final administrator are rejected.

delete.description: Requires `DELETE {username}` exactly. Self-delete and deletion of the final administrator are rejected and every attempt is audited.

get.summary: Read federation, remote, and plugin settings
get.description: Remote credential fields are recursively redacted.

post.summary: Upsert an ICE or Benchling remote
post.description: The configuration is write-only for secret fields; subsequent reads redact them.

post.summary: Cancel a queued or running job

get.summary: Read search deployment and rebuild status
Read complete-backup capability and recent jobs

post.description: Manual UI and pre-deploy requests enqueue the same durable complete_backup job used by the scheduler. The artifact includes RocksDB, blobs, search state, and ACME state.

get.summary: Read active and pending edge settings and live health

patch.summary: Validate and persist pending edge settings
patch.description: Settings are stored in the backend and included in complete RocksDB checkpoints. The running process remains on the active settings until restart. Credentials and recovery identities are not accepted.

200.description: Updated pending settings and restart state.

get.description: Normalized ACL-scoped discovery with text, biological facets, collection/owner/provenance/date narrowing, deterministic sorting, exact totals, and stable paging. The wire uses query parameters rather than V1's path grammar.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The free-text term. Absent browses the whole in-scope corpus.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Restrict to one rdf:type, given as a full IRI.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Restrict to one SBOL role, given as a full IRI.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Restrict to direct members of this collection IRI.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Restrict to objects owned by this user graph IRI.

parameters.name: provenance
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring over mutable provenance.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Defaults to ascending for name/IRI and descending otherwise.

200.description: A deterministic page of discovery hits with an exact total.

post.description: Executes a structured request against a registered strategy under the caller's ACL graph scope. This is additive to the compatibility GET operation.

200.description: A strategy-labelled page whose total explicitly declares its guarantee.
The immutable startup registry and configured default.

get.description: Returns exact distinct-subject counts for rdf:type and SBOL role values under the caller's ACL scope, enriched with ontology labels when available.

200.description: Visible type and role values ordered by count and label.

get.description: Align a query nucleotide string against the in-scope indexed sequences, ordered by `pagerank * percentMatch`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The query nucleotide string. `sequence` is accepted as an alias.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: An alias for `q`.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: `global` (the banded aligner, default) or `exact` (exact substring).

200.description: The aligned hits with a total.
